verses.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה הָעֲשִׂרִ֔ית בִּשְׁנַת לְצִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֧יא שְׁמֹנֶֽה־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה הַשָּׁנָ֛ה לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- hā·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh hā·‘ă·śi·rîṯ biš·naṯ lə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh hî šə·mō·neh- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh haš·šā·nāh lin·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar
verses.literal: This is the word that came to Jeremiah - from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah which was the eighteenth . . . . . . year of Nebuchadnezzar

verses.original: וְאָ֗ז חֵ֚יל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְיִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא הָיָ֤ה כָלוּא֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּֽית־ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’āz ḥêl me·leḵ bā·ḇel ṣā·rîm ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî hā·yāh ḵā·lū ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh ’ă·šer bêṯ- me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging . . . Jerusalem and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard which was in the palace of the king of Judah

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה כְּלָא֔וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ אַתָּ֨ה נִבָּ֜א כֹּ֚ה לֵאמֹ֗ר יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֜ן הַזֹּ֛את הָעִ֥יר אֶת־ בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh kə·lā·’ōw lê·mōr mad·dū·a‘ ’at·tāh nib·bā kōh lê·mōr Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî nō·ṯên haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr ’eṯ- bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ū·lə·ḵā·ḏāh
verses.literal: For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him saying Why are you prophesying like this You claim that the LORD says Behold I am about to deliver this city - into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will capture it

verses.original: וְצִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵ֖ט מִיַּ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י הִנָּתֹ֤ן יִנָּתֵן֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְדִבֶּר־ פִּ֣יו עִם־ פִּ֔יו תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃ וְעֵינָ֖יו אֶת־ עֵינוֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh lō yim·mā·lêṭ mî·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm kî hin·nā·ṯōn yin·nā·ṯên bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel wə·ḏib·ber- pîw ‘im- pîw tir·’e·nāh wə·‘ê·nāw ’eṯ- ʿē·nō
verses.literal: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans but he will surely be delivered . . . into the hand of the king of Babylon and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye

verses.original: יוֹלִ֤ךְ אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וּבָבֶ֞ל וְשָׁ֣ם יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַד־ פָּקְדִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֧י תִֽלָּחֲמ֛וּ אֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yō·w·liḵ ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ū·ḇā·ḇel wə·šām yih·yeh ‘aḏ- pā·qə·ḏî ’ō·ṯōw nə·’um- Yah·weh kî ṯil·lā·ḥă·mū ’eṯ- hak·kaś·dîm lō ṯaṣ·lî·ḥū
verses.literal: He will take - Zedekiah to Babylon where he will stay until I attend to him declares the LORD If you fight against the Chaldeans you will not succeed

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה הָיָ֥ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: yir·mə·yā·hū way·yō·mer də·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Jeremiah replied The word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה חֲנַמְאֵ֗ל בֶּן־ דֹּֽדְךָ֔ שַׁלֻּם֙ בָּ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר קְנֵ֣ה לְךָ֗ אֶת־ שָׂדִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת כִּ֥י לְךָ֛ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה לִקְנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḥă·nam·’êl ben- dō·ḏə·ḵā šal·lum bā ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr qə·nêh lə·ḵā ’eṯ- śā·ḏî ’ă·šer ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ kî lə·ḵā miš·paṭ hag·gə·’ul·lāh liq·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Behold Hanamel the son of your uncle Shallum is coming to you to say Buy for yourself - my field - in Anathoth for you have the right of redemption to buy it

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ כִּדְבַ֣ר בֶּן־ דֹּדִ֜י חֲנַמְאֵ֨ל וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לַי חֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י נָ֠א אֶת־ קְנֵ֣ה שָׂדִ֨י אֲשֶׁר־ בַּעֲנָת֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ין כִּֽי־ לְךָ֞ מִשְׁפַּ֧ט הַיְרֻשָּׁ֛ה וּלְךָ֥ הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה קְנֵה־ לָ֑ךְ וָאֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י הֽוּא׃ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- kiḏ·ḇar ben- dō·ḏî ḥă·nam·’êl way·yā·ḇō ’ê·lay ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay nā ’eṯ- qə·nêh śā·ḏî ’ă·šer- ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·mîn kî- lə·ḵā miš·paṭ hay·ruš·šāh ū·lə·ḵā hag·gə·’ul·lāh qə·nêh- lāḵ wā·’ê·ḏa‘ kî hū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then, as the LORD . . . had said my cousin . . . Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and urged me . . . Please - buy my field - in Anathoth - in the land of Benjamin for you own the right of inheritance and redemption Buy it for yourself Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD

verses.original: וָֽאֶקְנֶה֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵאֵ֛ת בַּעֲנָת֑וֹת בֶּן־ דֹּדִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲנַמְאֵ֥ל וָֽאֶשְׁקֲלָה־ לּוֹ֙ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה וַעֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים הַכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·neh ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh mê·’êṯ ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ ben- dō·ḏî ’ă·šer ḥă·nam·’êl wā·’eš·qă·lāh- lōw ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ šiḇ·‘āh wa·‘ă·śā·rāh šə·qā·lîm hak·kā·sep̄
verses.literal: So I bought - the field . . . in Anathoth from my cousin . . . - Hanamel and I weighed out - vvv seventeen . . . shekels of silver

verses.original: וָאֶכְתֹּ֤ב וָֽאֶחְתֹּ֔ם בַּסֵּ֙פֶר֙ וָאָעֵ֖ד עֵדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁקֹ֥ל הַכֶּ֖סֶף בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eḵ·tōḇ wā·’eḥ·tōm bas·sê·p̄er wā·’ā·‘êḏ ‘ê·ḏîm wā·’eš·qōl hak·ke·sep̄ bə·mō·zə·nā·yim
verses.literal: I signed and sealed the deed called in witnesses . . . and weighed out the silver on the scales

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֖ח אֶת־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה אֶת־ הֶֽחָת֛וּם הַמִּצְוָ֥ה וְהַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַגָּלֽוּי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh ’eṯ- he·ḥā·ṯūm ham·miṣ·wāh wə·ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·’eṯ- hag·gā·lui
verses.literal: Then I took - the deed of purchase the sealed copy with its terms and conditions as well as the open copy

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֞ן אֶת־ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֗ה אֶל־ בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־ מַחְסֵיָה֒ לְעֵינֵי֙ דֹּדִ֔י וּלְעֵינֵי֙ חֲנַמְאֵ֣ל הָֽעֵדִ֔ים הַכֹּתְבִ֖ים הַמִּקְנָ֑ה לְעֵינֵי֙ בְּסֵ֣פֶר כָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên ’eṯ- has·sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh ’el- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh ben- maḥ·sê·yāh lə·‘ê·nê dō·ḏî ū·lə·‘ê·nê ḥă·nam·’êl hā·‘ê·ḏîm hak·kō·ṯə·ḇîm ham·miq·nāh lə·‘ê·nê bə·sê·p̄er kāl- hay·yə·hū·ḏîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: and I gave - this deed . . . to Baruch son of Neriah the son of Mahseiah in the sight of my cousin . . . Hanamel and the witnesses who were signing the purchase . . . agreement and all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard

verses.original: לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ וָֽאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת בָּר֔וּךְ
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ê·nê·hem lê·mōr wā·’ă·ṣaw·weh ʾɛṯ bā·rūḵ
verses.literal: In their sight . . . I instructed - Baruch

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָמַר֩ לָק֣וֹחַ אֶת־ הָאֵ֡לֶּה אֵ֣ת הַסְּפָרִ֣ים הֶחָת֗וּם וְאֵ֨ת הַזֶּ֔ה הַגָּלוּי֙ סֵ֤פֶר הַזֶּ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת סֵפֶר֩ הַמִּקְנָ֨ה וּנְתַתָּ֖ם חָ֑רֶשׂ בִּכְלִי־ לְמַ֥עַן יַעַמְד֖וּ רַבִּֽים׃ס יָמִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: kōh- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar lā·qō·w·aḥ ’eṯ- hā·’êl·leh ’êṯ has·sə·p̄ā·rîm he·ḥā·ṯūm wə·’êṯ haz·zeh hag·gā·lui sê·p̄er haz·zeh wə·’êṯ sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh ū·nə·ṯat·tām ḥā·reś biḵ·lî- lə·ma·‘an ya·‘am·ḏū rab·bîm yā·mîm
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Take - these - deeds both the sealed copy - and the open copy of the - deed of purchase and put them in a clay jar to preserve them for a long time

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָמַ֛ר בָתִּ֛ים וְשָׂד֥וֹת וּכְרָמִ֖ים ע֣וֹד יִקָּנ֥וּ הַזֹּֽאת׃פ בָּאָ֥רֶץ
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar ḇāt·tîm wə·śā·ḏō·wṯ ū·ḵə·rā·mîm ‘ō·wḏ yiq·qā·nū haz·zōṯ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Houses fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֤י תִתִּי֙ אֶת־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֔ה אֶל־ בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ וָאֶתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê ṯit·tî ’eṯ- sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh ’el- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh lê·mōr wā·’eṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: After I had given - the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah . . . I prayed to the LORD

verses.original: אֲהָהּ֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֣ה׀ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֗יתָ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ הַגָּד֔וֹל בְּכֹֽחֲךָ֙ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ לֹֽא־ כָּל־ דָּבָֽר׃ יִפָּלֵ֥א מִמְּךָ֖
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ hag·gā·ḏō·wl bə·ḵō·ḥă·ḵā han·nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇiz·rō·‘ă·ḵā lō- kāl- dā·ḇār yip·pā·lê mim·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Oh Lord GOD . . . You have made - the heavens - and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm Nothing . . . . . . is too difficult for You

verses.original: עֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמְשַׁלֵּם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֔וֹת אֶל־ חֵ֥יק בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַגִּבּ֔וֹר הָאֵ֤ל שְׁמֽוֹ׃ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh ḥe·seḏ la·’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mə·šal·lêm ‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ’el- ḥêq bə·nê·hem ’a·ḥă·rê·hem hag·gā·ḏō·wl hag·gib·bō·wr hā·’êl šə·mōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: גְּדֹל֙ הָֽעֵצָ֔ה וְרַ֖ב הָעֲלִֽילִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ עֵינֶ֣יךָ פְקֻח֗וֹת עַל־ כָּל־ דַּרְכֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְכִפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: gə·ḏōl hā·‘ê·ṣāh wə·raḇ hā·‘ă·lî·lî·yāh ’ă·šer- ‘ê·ne·ḵā p̄ə·qu·ḥō·wṯ ‘al- kāl- dar·ḵê bə·nê ’ā·ḏām lā·ṯêṯ lə·’îš kiḏ·rā·ḵāw wə·ḵip̄·rî ma·‘ă·lā·lāw
verses.literal: the One great in counsel and mighty in deed whose eyes . . . are on all the ways of the sons of men to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֠מְתָּ אֹת֨וֹת וּמֹפְתִ֤ים בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ הַזֶּ֔ה הַיּ֣וֹם וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבָֽאָדָ֑ם וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־ שֵׁ֖ם לְּךָ֥ הַזֶּֽה׃ כַּיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: ’ă·še·r·śa- śam·tā ’ō·ṯō·wṯ ū·mō·p̄ə·ṯîm bə·’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- haz·zeh hay·yō·wm ū·ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇā·’ā·ḏām wat·ta·‘ă·śeh- šêm lə·ḵā haz·zeh kay·yō·wm
verses.literal: - You performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt and You do so to this very day both in Israel and among all mankind And You have made a name for Yourself as is the case to this day

verses.original: וַתֹּצֵ֛א אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֥ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּאֹת֣וֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֗ים חֲזָקָה֙ וּבְיָ֤ד נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְאֶזְר֣וֹעַ גָּדֽוֹל׃ וּבְמוֹרָ֖א
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·ṣê ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim bə·’ō·ṯō·wṯ ū·ḇə·mō·wp̄·ṯîm ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇə·yāḏ nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇə·’ez·rō·w·a‘ gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇə·mō·w·rā
verses.literal: You brought - Your people - Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror

verses.original: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ הַזֹּ֔את הָאָ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·tên lā·hem ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tā lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: You gave them - this land that You had sworn to give their fathers a land flowing with milk and honey

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֗הּ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֤וּ בְקוֹלֶ֙ךָ֙ הָלָ֔כוּ אֵת֩ וּבְתֹרוֹתֶךָ לֹא־ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לֹ֣א כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֧יתָה לָהֶ֛ם עָשׂ֑וּ וַתַּקְרֵ֣א אֹתָ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַזֹּֽאת׃ הָרָעָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·yir·šū ’ō·ṯāh wə·lō- šā·mə·‘ū ḇə·qō·w·le·ḵā hā·lā·ḵū ’êṯ ū·ḇə·ṯō·rō·ṯɛ·ḵå̄ lō- la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lō kāl- ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯāh lā·hem ‘ā·śū wat·taq·rê ’ō·ṯām ’êṯ kāl- haz·zōṯ hā·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: They came in and possessed it - but they did not obey Your voice or walk - in Your law They failed to perform . . . all that You commanded them to do and so You have brought upon them all this disaster

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה הַסֹּלְל֗וֹת בָּ֣אוּ הָעִיר֮ לְלָכְדָהּ֒ מִפְּנֵ֛י הַחֶ֥רֶב וְהָרָעָ֖ב וְהַדָּ֑בֶר וְהָעִ֣יר נִתְּנָ֗ה בְּיַ֤ד הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יהָ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתָּ הָיָ֖ה וְהִנְּךָ֥ רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh has·sō·lə·lō·wṯ bā·’ū hā·‘îr lə·lā·ḵə·ḏāh mip·pə·nê ha·ḥe·reḇ wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ wə·had·dā·ḇer wə·hā·‘îr nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm han·nil·ḥā·mîm ‘ā·le·hā wa·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā hā·yāh wə·hin·nə·ḵā rō·’eh
verses.literal: See how the siege ramps are mounted against the city to capture it And by sword and famine and plague the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it What You have spoken has happened as You now see

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ אֵלַי֙ קְנֵֽה־ לְךָ֧ הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִ֑ים וְהָעִ֥יר נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lay qə·nêh- lə·ḵā haś·śā·ḏeh bak·ke·sep̄ wə·hā·‘êḏ ‘ê·ḏîm wə·hā·‘îr nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm
verses.literal: Yet You O Lord GOD have said to me Buy for yourself the field with silver and call in witnesses even though the city has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans

verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיְהִי֙ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah . . .

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר כָּל־ דָּבָֽר׃ יִפָּלֵ֖א הֲ‍ֽמִמֶּ֔נִּי
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê kāl- bā·śār kāl- dā·ḇār yip·pā·lê hămim·men·nî
verses.literal: Behold I am the LORD the God of all flesh Is anything . . . too difficult for Me

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֖ה יְהוָ֑ה אָמַ֣ר הִנְנִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ הַזֹּ֜את הָעִ֨יר אֶת־ בְּיַ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וּבְיַ֛ד נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî nō·ṯên haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr ’eṯ- bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm ū·ḇə·yaḏ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ū·lə·ḵā·ḏāh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says Behold I am about to deliver this city - into the hands of the Chaldeans and of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon who will capture it

verses.original: הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הַנִּלְחָמִים֙ עַל־ הַזֹּ֔את הָעִ֣יר וּבָ֣אוּ הַזֹּ֛את הָעִ֥יר וְהִצִּ֜יתוּ אֶת־ בָּאֵ֖שׁ וּשְׂרָפ֑וּהָ וְאֵ֣ת הַבָּתִּ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃ קִטְּר֨וּ לַבַּ֗עַל עַל־ גַּגּֽוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם וְהִסִּ֤כוּ נְסָכִים֙ אֲחֵרִ֔ים לֵאלֹהִ֣ים לְמַ֖עַן
verses.transliteration: hak·kaś·dîm han·nil·ḥā·mîm ‘al- haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr ū·ḇā·’ū haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr wə·hiṣ·ṣî·ṯū ’eṯ- bā·’êš ū·śə·rā·p̄ū·hā wə·’êṯ hab·bāt·tîm ’ă·šer haḵ·‘i·sê·nî qiṭ·ṭə·rū lab·ba·‘al ‘al- gag·gō·w·ṯê·hem wə·his·si·ḵū nə·sā·ḵîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lê·lō·hîm lə·ma·‘an
verses.literal: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come in set [it] on fire - - and burn it along with the houses of those who provoked Me to anger by burning incense to Baal on their rooftops and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods -

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָי֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֹשִׂ֥ים אַ֣ךְ הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י מִנְּעֻרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַ֣ךְ מַכְעִסִ֥ים אֹתִ֛י בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ‘ō·śîm ’aḵ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nay min·nə·‘u·rō·ṯê·hem kî ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’aḵ maḵ·‘i·sîm ’ō·ṯî bə·ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For . . . the children of Israel and of Judah have done nothing but evil in My sight from their youth indeed [they] . . . have done nothing but provoke Me to anger - by the work of their hands declares the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֧י הַזֹּ֔את הָעִ֣יר עַל־ אַפִּ֣י וְעַל־ חֲמָתִ֗י הָ֤יְתָה לִּי֙ לְמִן־ הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לַהֲסִירָ֖הּ מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr ‘al- ’ap·pî wə·‘al- ḥă·mā·ṯî hā·yə·ṯāh lî lə·min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer bā·nū ’ō·w·ṯāh wə·‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh la·hă·sî·rāh mê·‘al pā·nāy
verses.literal: For this city has aroused My wrath . . . and fury . . . from the day - it was built - until now . . . . . . Therefore I will remove it from My presence

verses.original: עַל֩ כָּל־ רָעַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְהַכְעִסֵ֔נִי הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִֽיאֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al kāl- rā·‘aṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū lə·haḵ·‘i·sê·nî hêm·māh mal·ḵê·hem śā·rê·hem kō·hă·nê·hem ū·nə·ḇî·’ê·hem wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: because of all the evil the children of Israel and of Judah - have done to provoke Me to anger they their kings their officials their priests and prophets the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֥וּ עֹ֖רֶף אֵלַ֛י וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וְלַמֵּ֤ד אֹתָם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְלַמֵּ֔ד וְאֵינָ֥ם שֹׁמְעִ֖ים לָקַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·nū ‘ō·rep̄ ’ê·lay wə·lō p̄ā·nîm wə·lam·mêḏ ’ō·ṯām haš·kêm wə·lam·mêḏ wə·’ê·nām šō·mə·‘îm lā·qa·ḥaṯ mū·sār
verses.literal: They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces Though I taught them again and again . . . they would not listen or respond to discipline

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָֽא־ שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śî·mū šiq·qū·ṣê·hem bab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- niq·rā- šə·mî ‘ā·lāw lə·ṭam·mə·’ōw
verses.literal: They have placed their abominations in the house that bears My Name and so have defiled it

verses.original: וַיִּבְנוּ֩ אֶת־ בָּמ֨וֹת הַבַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֗ם בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם֮ לְ֠הַעֲבִיר אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם וְאֶת־ לַמֹּלֶךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְלֹ֤א עָֽלְתָה֙ עַל־ לִבִּ֔י לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַזֹּ֑את לְמַ֖עַן הַתּוֹעֵבָ֣ה יְהוּדָֽה׃ס הַחֲטִי אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·nū ’eṯ- bā·mō·wṯ hab·ba·‘al ’ă·šer bə·ḡê ḇen- hin·nōm bə·nō·w·ṯê·hem lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem wə·’eṯ- lam·mō·leḵ ’ă·šer lō- ṣiw·wî·ṯîm wə·lō ‘ā·lə·ṯāh ‘al- lib·bî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ haz·zōṯ lə·ma·‘an hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh yə·hū·ḏāh ha·ḥă·ṭī ’eṯ-
verses.literal: They have built - the high places of Baal in the Valley of Ben-hinnom to make their sons . . . and daughters pass through - - - the fire to Molech something I never commanded them nor had it ever entered . . . My mind that they should commit such . . . an abomination and cause Judah to sin -

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לָכֵ֛ן אֶל־ הַזֹּ֜את הָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִתְּנָה֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֥ב וּבַדָּֽבֶר׃ כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָמַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lā·ḵên ’el- haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr ’ă·šer ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ba·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·dā·ḇer kōh- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar
verses.literal: Now therefore about this city of which you say It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword and famine and plague this is what the LORD the God of Israel says

verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י מְקַבְּצָם֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָׁ֛ם בְּאַפִּ֥י וּבַחֲמָתִ֖י גָּד֑וֹל וּבְקֶ֣צֶף וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ אֶל־ הַזֶּ֔ה הַמָּק֣וֹם וְהֹשַׁבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mə·qab·bə·ṣām mik·kāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tîm šām bə·’ap·pî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯî gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇə·qe·ṣep̄ wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯîm ’el- haz·zeh ham·mā·qō·wm wə·hō·šaḇ·tîm lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ
verses.literal: vvv I will surely gather [My people] from all the lands to which I have banished them . . . in My furious anger . . . and great wrath and I will return them to this place and make them dwell in safety

verses.original: וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lî lə·‘ām wa·’ă·nî ’eh·yeh lā·hem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: They will be My people and I will be their God

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֜ם אֶחָד֙ לֵ֤ב אֶחָ֔ד וְדֶ֣רֶךְ לְיִרְאָ֥ה אוֹתִ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים לְט֣וֹב לָהֶ֔ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem ’e·ḥāḏ lêḇ ’e·ḥāḏ wə·ḏe·reḵ lə·yir·’āh ’ō·w·ṯî kāl- hay·yā·mîm lə·ṭō·wḇ lā·hem wə·liḇ·nê·hem ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: I will give them one heart and one way so that they will always fear Me - - . . . for their own good and for the good of their children after them

verses.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּרִ֣ית לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־ אָשׁוּב֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם לְהֵיטִיבִ֖י אוֹתָ֑ם וְאֶת־ אֶתֵּ֣ן יִרְאָתִי֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י ס֥וּר מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·rat·tî ‘ō·w·lām ’ă·šer bə·rîṯ lā·hem lō- ’ā·šūḇ mê·’a·ḥă·rê·hem lə·hê·ṭî·ḇî ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’eṯ- ’et·tên yir·’ā·ṯî bil·ḇā·ḇām lə·ḇil·tî sūr mê·‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: I will make an everlasting - covenant with them I will never turn away from doing good to them - - and I will put My fear in their hearts so that they will never turn away from Me

verses.original: וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְהֵטִ֣יב אוֹתָ֑ם בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת וּנְטַעְתִּ֞ים הַזֹּאת֙ בָּאָ֤רֶץ בְּכָל־ לִבִּ֖י וּבְכָל־ נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·śaś·tî ‘ă·lê·hem lə·hê·ṭîḇ ’ō·w·ṯām be·’ĕ·meṯ ū·nə·ṭa‘·tîm haz·zōṯ bā·’ā·reṣ bə·ḵāl lib·bî ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Yes , I will rejoice in doing them good - and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ כָּל־ הַזֹּ֑את הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הָרָעָ֥ה אֶל־ הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֛ת הָעָ֣ם כֵּ֣ן אָנֹכִ֞י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ka·’ă·šer hê·ḇê·ṯî kāl- haz·zōṯ hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh hā·rā·‘āh ’el- haz·zeh ’êṯ hā·‘ām kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·ḇî ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- kāl- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî dō·ḇêr ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says Just as I have brought all this great disaster on this - people so I will bring on them all the good - I have promised them

verses.original: הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְנִקְנָ֥ה הַזֹּ֑את בָּאָ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים הִיא֙ שְׁמָמָ֥ה מֵאֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ וּבְהֵמָ֔ה נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ḏeh wə·niq·nāh haz·zōṯ bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm hî šə·mā·māh mê·’ên ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm
verses.literal: And fields will be bought in this land about which you are saying It is a desolation without man or beast it has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans

verses.original: שָׂד֞וֹת יִקְנ֗וּ בַּכֶּ֣סֶף בַּסֵּ֥פֶר׀ וְכָת֨וֹב וְחָתוֹם֮ וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִים֒ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן וּבִסְבִיבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּבְעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וּבְעָרֵ֥י הַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י הַנֶּ֑גֶב כִּֽי־ אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ שְׁבוּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: śā·ḏō·wṯ yiq·nū bak·ke·sep̄ bas·sê·p̄er wə·ḵā·ṯō·wḇ wə·ḥā·ṯō·wm wə·hā·‘êḏ ‘ê·ḏîm bə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min ū·ḇis·ḇî·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê hā·hār ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê han·ne·ḡeḇ kî- ’ā·šîḇ ’eṯ- šə·ḇū·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Fields will be purchased with silver and deeds will be signed sealed vvv and witnessed in the land of Benjamin in the areas surrounding Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah the cities of the hill country - the foothills [and] the Negev because I will restore them - from captivity declares the LORD
